about: Made by tools/art-import/import_art.py. Do not edit by hand; re-run the script.
frameFormat: [page, x, y, w, h, trimX, trimY, fullW, fullH]

groundMotion.note: planted feet stay still when fps = speed (tiles/s) * fpsPerTilePerSec; at the design speed that is the fps above

strike.note: Batch 1: small lunge, hips and shoulders turn so it reads from the front

jab.note: basic attack: play once per attack (0.3 s); the last frame flows back into idle frame 0

bow.note: 22 frames = 1.375 s; legs straight (knees soft, not locked) once the feet are together, the 30-degree bend is only from the hips; the head stays up, eyes on the partner; frames 0-3 step the feet together, 19-21 return to the guard. For the game's current 0.9 s, play frames 3-18 at 16 fps (1.0 s) or the whole bow at 24 fps

defeat.note: play once, then hold the last frame during the fade and 'Ouch! Back to the start.'

dash.note: 8 frames = 0.4 s. Played in place; the game moves him 2.5 tiles during frames 1-5 (0.25 s). Ends on the guard

hit.note: hit flinch, 5 frames = 0.25 s, small head/shoulder recoil, ends on the guard

sweep.note: loop, 0.8 s; draw prop-broom (no tint). One loop = two strokes

wipe.note: loop, 1.0 s, one circle per loop; draw prop-rag (no tint). Play while the player taps Wipe

straighten.note: one-shot, 14 frames = 1.17 s: reach out at chest height and set the item level (weapon rack), ends on the guard

celebrate.note: promotion ceremony, 24 frames = 1.5 s, then hold the last frame (proud stance, fists at the hips so the new belt is in full view)

beltStyles.note: chosen belt style (belt revision, option C): tint per layer for each Action Zone belt (fixtures/); a layer that is not listed is not drawn (belt-center-edge is never drawn in this style). Tape stripes keep the belt.ts rule
